name: The Forging of Quel'Serrar
label: Quest
description: The Forging of Quel'Serrar: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you wish to take on this task, present Lydros with the dull blade.

clips.title: Completion
paras: If you manage to enter the lair of the dragon, heat the blade under her fiery breath, and ultimately temper it in her blood, I shall bind the blade for your use.
